external.G7: CI green on the evidence commit

sentences: `actinv unfold` estimates a neutron spectrum from foil activities, modelled with a full ACTINV solve of each foil's irradiation history, and from reaction rates, carrying the library's cross-section covariance into the fit.

On 40 synthetic spectra drawn from its prior, 97% of the true band fluxes fell inside its 95% intervals and 69% inside one standard deviation, and its band fluxes were closer to the truth than the prior's (root-mean-square log error 0.138 against 0.208).

On IRDFF-II's measured spectrum-averaged cross sections in the Cf-252 and U-235 fission fields, predicting each reaction left out of the fit, the median |ln(C/E)| was Cf-252-a prior (the other field): 0.321 → 0.087, UNFOLD CLOSER, p = 3e-08; Cf-252-b prior (a Maxwellian): 0.158 → 0.080, UNFOLD CLOSER, p = 0.00068; U-235-a prior (the other field): 0.246 → 0.044, UNFOLD CLOSER, p = 1.3e-05; U-235-b prior (a Maxwellian): 1.031 → 0.048, UNFOLD CLOSER, p = 2e-09; the Cf-252 reference spectrum used similar measurements in its evaluation.
